caption.ig:
If a US airline cancels your flight and you turn down the new one, DOT rules say you can get your money back, not just a voucher. This agent reads your booking, checks what you're owed and writes the refund request for you to send. Sample booking shown. Comment REFUND and I'll DM you the agent. 30% off this week with LAUNCH30.

Education only, not financial advice.
